$comment: Skeptic output for client-issues: adversarial check of one candidate. zip_filter keeps the left-side candidate when real==true and evidence is a non-empty array.
title: VerdictResult

id.$comment: Must match the candidate id under review so operators can align verdicts with claims.

real.$comment: true only when the issue is independently supportable. false drops the candidate in zip_filter.

reason.$comment: Short rationale for real/false—what was checked and why it passed or failed.

evidence.$comment: Independent citations the skeptic verified (not a blind copy of the candidate's claims). Empty array ⇒ zip_filter drops even if real were true.

items.$comment: Same citation shape as candidates: source + quote. source may be path or URL.

source.description: Where the quote came from (path, URL, or other locator)

quote.$comment: Excerpt that justifies the real flag (or documents the contradiction when real is false).
